text.tspan: ① 地热水从裂隙储层开采，经换热降温后回灌。
② 板式换热器将地热水与热泵源侧水路隔离。
③ 热泵消耗电能提升供热温度，供暖水输送热量。

g.text: 热泵能量平衡：Qₕ = Qɢ + W（忽略热损失）

g.text: Qₕ：供热量；Qɢ：地热取热量；W：压缩机电能输入

svg.metadata: Original editable schematic for a fractured medium-deep geothermal heat-pump coupled heating system. Doublet production/reinjection wells, plate heat exchanger, isolated source loop, vapor-compression heat pump and closed building heating loop. Conceptual diagram, not site-specific design. All text and equipment are native SVG objects.
